propositions: config.py is near the 800-LOC cap with only seven lines of headroom, blocking a dependent deprecation-alias ticket.
The inert gate read-root/snapshot-session domain (ContextVars and functions like gate_session, use_code_root, assert_gated) is extracted into a new gate_context.py module.
Moved names must be re-exported from llm.config so no src consumer is repointed, keeping 13 function-level import monkeypatch targets working without any test edits.
gate_context must not create an import cycle: it imports only stdlib, rebar.config, and a lazy rebar.llm.errors, never llm.config.
assert_gated's hardcoded logger name rebar.llm.config is repointed to gate_context so the audited REBAR_GATE_ALLOW_UNGATED override warning is attributed to the correct module.
The shared seam-guard loop covering config.py and workflow_ops.py must be split into per-file bounds so tightening config.py to <700 does not falsely fail the sibling ticket's file.
